differences.detail: Save with format="auto_round" (scheme W4A16: sym=True, group_size=128, int). For sym int this packs GPTQ-style (qweight int32 [in/8,out], qzeros [in/128,out/8] stored zp-1, fp16 scales [in/128,out], trivial g_idx) and writes quantization_config {quant_method: auto-round, packing_format: auto_round:auto_gptq, bits 4, group_size 128, sym true, block_name_to_quantize model.layers}. This is the only built-in format that (a) reloads in transformers with just auto_round + triton in this venv and (b) vLLM serves on Ampere via its auto-round quant method -> GPTQ-Marlin (uint4b8, sym, g128). auto_gptq writes quant_method gptq, whose transformers loader needs optimum + gptqmodel/auto-gptq (not installed); auto_awq is asym-only; llm_compressor needs compressed-tensors for the transformers reload. Do not use fake or keep fp16 RTN as the deliverable.

quantize_and_save(output_dir=X) does not write into X: it derives X/<basename(model path)>-w4g128 (e.g. X/Qwen_Qwen3-8B-w4g128 when loading the local snapshot) and returns that folder. The wrapper must leave config.json, quantization config and safetensors directly in OUTPUT_DIR (or the smoke output dir): move the returned folder's contents up into OUTPUT_DIR and delete the empty subfolder, or call quantize() then save_quantized(OUTPUT_DIR, format="auto_round") (single format writes straight to output_dir).

Reload in transformers via AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(OUTPUT_DIR, device_map="cuda:0", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16 or float16); quant_method auto-round routes to AutoRoundQuantizer -> auto_round.inference.convert_hf_model. With backend auto on CUDA and packing auto_round:auto_gptq the candidates are gptqmodel:marlin_zp (needs gptqmodel), auto_round:humming_zp (needs humming), auto_round:tritonv2_zp (needs triton>=2.0), auto_round:torch_zp. Only triton 3.3.1 is installed, so require auto_round:tritonv2_zp; pin it with quantization_config=AutoRoundConfig(backend="tritonv2_zp") so the verify/benchmark result does not silently change if gptqmodel appears later. No extra packages needed. The kernel needs in/out features multiple of 32 (all Qwen3 linears are).

lm_head (untied, 151936x4096) and model.embed_tokens stay in model dtype, matching paper 4.1 and the repo default quant_lm_head=False; do not pass quant_lm_head or an lm_head layer_config entry. Quantized linears are exactly the 7 per block x 36 = 252 in model.layers; the smoke coverage target should be those decoder linears, not lm_head. vLLM loads lm_head unquantized.

Qwen3 adds q_norm/k_norm RMSNorms after q_proj/k_proj. AutoRound is weight-only with no rotation or smoothing, so no invariant touches them: they are not Linears, not wrapped (norm tuning off), stay bf16, and their effect is inside the block-output MSE the tuner minimizes. No patch.

GQA 32/8 heads, head_dim 128: k_proj/v_proj out_features 1024. Groups run along in_features (4096 -> 32 groups), so grouping is unchanged. vLLM fuses q/k/v (N=6144) and gate/up (N=24576); all share bits 4 / g128 / sym under the single W4A16 scheme, and N is a multiple of 64 and K (4096, 12288) a multiple of 128, as Marlin requires.

Paper evaluates asymmetric quantization (Eq. 2-4); the repo's W4A16 default is full-range symmetric (q in [-8,7], scale = +-max/8, may be negative, implicit zero 8). Keep sym=True: it is what the GPTQ-Marlin path serves (uint4b8, no zero points) and the packed u=q+8 dequantizes exactly as (u-8)*scale. Switching to asym would force AWQ packing (auto_round:auto_awq) and a different vLLM kernel path.

Calibration: default dataset NeelNanda/pile-10k (train, seed 42) is fetched from the HF Hub at run time; it is not cached on the host (HF_HOME datasets only has wikitext) but the Hub answered 200. On load failure the repo silently falls back to fineweb-edu (also Hub). Recommend dataset="NeelNanda/pile-10k" explicitly with nsamples=128, seqlen=2048, batch_size=8; if the Hub stalls, pass a list[str] of the first N texts read line-by-line from .cache/calib/pile-val-backup/val.jsonl (Pile validation, not pile-10k; avoid passing the 1.4 GB file path because the local loader reads all of it). Smoke hooks: QUANT_AGENT_SMOKE_CALIB_SAMPLES -> nsamples, QUANT_AGENT_SMOKE_SEQ_LEN -> seqlen, QUANT_AGENT_SMOKE=1 -> iters 2-5 (lr auto = 1/iters).

Memory on a 24 GB RTX 3090: repo measured 18 GB peak for an 8B model at W4G128 with torch.compile and low_gpu_mem_usage=False, 10 GB with low_gpu_mem_usage=True. Run with device_map=0, low_gpu_mem_usage=False first; on OOM retry with low_gpu_mem_usage=True (then gradient_accumulate_steps=8, batch_size=1). Expect ~30-50 min tuning (~50-75 min with low_gpu_mem_usage).
The method keeps linear biases in fp (and only tunes them with enable_norm_bias_tuning). Qwen3-8B has no linear biases, so nothing applies.
